_comment: Vendored snapshot of the official DeepSWE leaderboard. Do not hand-edit -- regenerate by re-fetching source_data_url and re-applying row_selection_rule, then update snapshot_date. See report.py's module docstring for how this file is consumed.
honesty_note: Every official number below was produced with mini-swe-agent, a minimal single-agent scaffold -- NOT claude-code / the sadd plugin this benchmark harness measures. mini-swe-agent and claude-code differ in tool access, context management, and prompting, so these numbers are context for where a model tier sits on an independent benchmark, not a like-for-like comparison against this harness's own arms.
row_selection_rule: The DeepSWE site itself runs each model at several 'reasoning_effort' configs (low/medium/high/xhigh/max) and its own live-leaderboard UI collapses them to one displayed row per model by picking the row with the highest available reasoning_effort (verified by reading the compiled `mt()`/`V()` helpers in the site's own assets/live-leaderboard-*.js bundle, and cross-checking that the resulting numbers for claude-opus-5 and claude-sonnet-5 match the human-visible table at https://deepswe.datacurve.ai/). This snapshot reproduces that exact selection so these numbers match what a visitor sees by default.

field_notes.pass_at_1: Fraction (0-1) of scored rollout attempts that passed, at the selected reasoning_effort.
field_notes.ci_low / ci_high: DeepSWE's own 95% CI: run-to-run standard error across repeated whole-benchmark passes (1.96 * std(runs) / sqrt(n_runs)) -- NOT a Wilson interval, so do not plot it interchangeably with this harness's own pass_at_1_ci_low/high without noting the different method.
field_notes.avg_cost_usd / avg_output_tokens / avg_n: Mean over every scored attempt at the selected reasoning_effort (mean_cost_usd / mean_output_tokens / mean_agent_steps in the source JSON).

haiku.absence_reason: No claude-haiku-* row exists anywhere in the fetched v1.1 dataset (53 rows spanning 21 distinct models, checked across every reasoning_effort). DeepSWE has not benchmarked a Haiku-tier Claude model as of the snapshot date. Recording this absence explicitly rather than inventing a number.
